Rice can be considered one of the original inhabitants of Gracetown.
On the day it was born, the town was engulfed in raging flames, and people fled in all directions. Its owner closed their eyes before even giving it a name.
Later, many people came to Gracetown, and Rice was overjoyed because a woman wearing a headscarf took it home. Rice's owner was also happy because golden crops began to grow in the fields again.
When autumn arrived, Rice's owner rubbed the plump rice husks, laughing and crying through tears. Through blurred vision, they saw a Dog playing in the field and said, "From now on, your name will be Rice."
Rice knew that, just like itself, its owner had found a home again in Gracetown.
